meaning:
βυθός, -οῦ, ὁ,
[in LXX: Exo.15:5, Neh.9:11 (מְצוֹלָה), Psa.67 (68):22 68 (69):2, 15 106 (107):24 (מְצוּלָה)* ;]

2. the depth of the sea, the deep sea: 2Co.11:25.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.
